text:
sam (DevEx): quick design check— updated schema assistant modal (tool-calling flow). changed primary label and added compact preview; attaching mock: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/schema-modal-v3.png

liz (Design): :eyes: much tighter spacing. couple things: primary label 'Apply schema' feels ambiguous vs 'Save'. can we have primary = 'Apply changes', secondary = 'Preview validation', tertiary = 'Close'? also header feels crowded with 'Run history' link.

omar (Eng): agree on label hierarchy. minor bug: when opening preview the focus lands on the preview container. reproducer: open modal -> press Tab -> focus should be first schema field, not preview close button.

kevin (A11y): yep need focus-trap + aria-modal. Also no live region for validation errors atm. add aria-live="polite" but announce summary only (e.g., 'Validation: 2 errors, 1 warning') to avoid spamming screen readers.

matt (DevEx): implementation note: current code intentionally focuses preview for assistive tech, but we should focus first input on open and only move focus to preview when user explicitly toggles it.

sam (DevEx): copy thought: primary -> 'Apply changes' (shorter). preview button to 'Preview validation' to hint it runs validation. secondary vs tertiary semantics ok?

liz (Design): 'Apply changes' works. header: move 'Open run history' into kebab menu, and surface an inline 'View run history' link beneath the preview summary so power users can get to it.

kevin (A11y): focus indicator: ensure visible focus ring that doesn't rely on color. outline + subtle box-shadow. follow 3:1 contrast for focus strokes on small controls.

omar (Eng): validation runs async and highlights lines. aria-live summary only then provide expandable details is good. we should debounce announcements (700ms) to avoid announcing while typing. errors must be adjacent in DOM after relevant input.

sam (DevEx): agreed. action items: 1) primary label -> 'Apply changes' 2) move run history to kebab + inline link under preview 3) focus trap so first input gets focus 4) aria-live summary + 700ms debounce 5) visible non-color focus ring 6) gutter icon + soft background for error lines. volunteers?

omar (Eng): Ill take focus trap + debounce + aria-live summary patch.

liz (Design): Ill push copy tweaks and mock kebab placement.

kevin (A11y): Ill draft a short accessibility checklist for the modal (aria-modal, live region, focus order, contrast, non-color indicators).

matt (DevEx): Ill add inline 'View run history' link in preview summary mock and a tiny tooltip for the kebab explaining where run history moved to.

sam (DevEx): can we get quick a11y + focus fix merged first? then follow up with copy + visuals.

omar (Eng): yes prioritizing that now.

kevin (A11y): after PR please run NVDA/VoiceOver smoke. Ill sign off asap.

liz (Design): small visual nit: error highlights should not be red-only. add icon in gutter + subtle beige/pale tint for background. also ensure the inline preview summary uses text + icon to convey pass/warn/error.

sam (DevEx): thanks team. Ill update the ticket with tasks and ETA. :thumbsup:
